result.instructions: Tools for Freshchat, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which conversations are still open and assigned to nobody?"; "Show me the latest messages in the conversation with Jane Smith."; "Which agents are active in the Billing group?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Freshchat data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run freshchat_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run freshchat_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run freshchat_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. freshchat_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: freshchat_get_account
tools.title: Get account configuration
tools.description: Get the Freshchat account configuration for the connected account. Good first call to confirm the connection. Freshchat API: GET /v2/accounts/configuration.

tools.name: freshchat_list_users
tools.title: Find users
tools.description: Find customer users. The API needs at least one filter: first_name, last_name, email, reference_id or phone_no. Freshchat API: GET /v2/users.

reference_id.description: Match users by your own reference id.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, for example email or created_time.

tools.name: freshchat_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one customer user by id, with e-mail, name, phone and custom properties. Freshchat API: GET /v2/users/{user_id}.

tools.name: freshchat_list_user_conversations
tools.title: List a user's conversations
tools.description: List the conversation ids of one customer user. Freshchat API: GET /v2/users/{user_id}/conversations.

tools.name: freshchat_get_conversation
tools.title: Get a conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation: assignment, status, channel, users and properties. Freshchat API: GET /v2/conversations/{conversation_id}.

tools.name: freshchat_list_messages
tools.title: List messages in a conversation
tools.description: List the messages of one conversation, oldest first. Use from_time to read only newer messages. Freshchat API: GET /v2/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages.

from_time.description: Only messages created at or after this UTC time, e.g. 2026-11-01T10:00:00.000Z.

tools.name: freshchat_send_message
tools.title: Send a message to a conversation
tools.description: Send a plain-text agent reply into a conversation. The customer sees it at once. Freshchat API: POST /v2/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages.

user_id.description: The customer user id the reply is for (from freshchat_get_conversation).

actor_id.description: The agent id who sends the reply (from freshchat_list_agents).

annotations.title: Send a message to a conversation

tools.name: freshchat_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List support agents, with their groups, roles and availability. Freshchat API: GET /v2/agents.

is_deactivated.description: true for deactivated agents only, false for active agents only.

tools.name: freshchat_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List agent groups (teams that conversations are assigned to). Freshchat API: GET /v2/groups.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, for example name.

tools.name: freshchat_list_channels
tools.title: List channels
tools.description: List channels (topics) that new conversations are created under. Freshchat API: GET /v2/channels.

locale.description: ISO-639 language code, for example en or de. Filters channels by language.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Freshchat
prompts.description: What you can do with Freshchat here, with example requests to try.
